description: Single source of truth for the Emscripten toolchain pin and compile/link flags. Consumed by wasm_renderer/build.sh (via scripts/format-wasm-compile-flags.js), wasm_renderer/CMakeLists.txt (thin wrapper that invokes build.sh), scripts/emcc-version-gate.sh and the CI wasm job (setup-emsdk version must equal emsdkVersion). Export lists live in wasm_exports.json. `sources` (relative to wasm_renderer/) is the translation-unit list build.sh links and `npm run wasm:compile-commands` indexes; it must equal the tracked wasm_renderer/*.cpp set. Two artifacts are built from the same sources: the top-level graph (sFlags, jsOutputName) is the ASYNCIFY fallback and keeps today's ABI; the `jspi` graph swaps ASYNCIFY for JSPI and is loaded only where WebAssembly.Suspending exists (src/wasm/bridge/init.ts). Never ship JSPI-only. WaitAny init needs one of the two — see wasm_renderer/BUILD_FLAG_EXPERIMENTS.md before touching either. GROWABLE_ARRAYBUFFERS=0 is deliberate (TextDecoder + resizable heap); do not flip without a Dawn re-test.

jspi.description: JSPI primary graph. sFlags must equal the fallback sFlags with ASYNCIFY replaced by JSPI (verify:wasm-invariants). jspiExports lists every C export whose call graph can reach wgpuInstanceWaitAny; each becomes Promise-returning and the bridge must ccall it with { async: true } via src/wasm/bridge/call.ts SUSPENDING_EXPORTS. Calling an unlisted export that suspends traps under JSPI.

waitAnyCallGraph.initWasmRenderer: Initialize → CreateDevice (adapter, device, format-probe error scope WaitAny) → CreateResources → CreateHistoryTextureFailSoft → TryCreateHistoryTexture (error scope WaitAny)
